BiblicalUsage: To tread down, as the fourth beast in Daniel's vision devours the whole earth, treads it down, and breaks it in pieces.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the beast that treads down the earth is already measured by God, because the Ancient of Days sits above every kingdom that tramples.
